Visualises bulk differential intensity results

Source: R/bulkPanel_DASummaryTab.R
BulkPanel_DASummaryTab.Rd

Shiny module for visual summaries of results from the Differential intensity analysis module. Provides heatmap of selected peaks and volcano/MA plots.

Usage

BulkPanel_DASummaryTabUI(id, bulk.metadata, show = TRUE)

BulkPanel_DASummaryTabServer(
  id,
  bulk.intensity.matrix,
  bulk.metadata,
  de.results,
  anno
)

Arguments

id

Shiny module id (for both UI and server)

bulk.metadata

A data.frame with sample-level metadata

show

Logical flag whether to include this tab in the UI (default TRUE)

bulk.intensity.matrix

Reactive matrix of peak intensities (rows = peaks, cols = samples)

de.results

Reactive object returned by the DE analysis module (provides DEtable, DEtableSubset, selectedPeaks())

anno

Annotation data.frame for peaks (must contain m_z and display_name/name fields)

Details

The panel pulls peak sets from the linked differential intensity analysis module. Heatmap rows can be clustered and annotated using sample metadata. Volcano/MA visual summarise differential peaks with convenient download options.
